info.name: Partnerize Brands Attribution Deep link domains API
Fetches allowed deeplink domains for the given brand.

params.name: brand
params.description: Brand ID to get allowed domains for

params.name: limit
params.description: Limits the number of results returned. Defaults to 20

items.docs: Fetches allowed deeplink domains for a given brand. Results are ordered by domain name in ascending order.

info.name: Adds allowed deeplink domains for the given brand.

params.name: brand
params.description: Brand ID to modify allowed domains for

items.docs: Adds a number of allowed deeplink domains for the given Brand. A maximum of 100 domains can be added at once.

info.name: Removes allowed deeplink domains for the given brand.

params.name: brand
params.description: Brand ID to remove allowed domains for

items.docs: Removes a number of allowed deeplink domains for the given Brand. A maximum of 100 domains can be removed at once.
